mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over one month signals improving labor market conditions, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases by >0.3pp in 1 month but SPX returns are negative in >40% of next 20-day windows over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than $10,000 million over one month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by >$10k million in 1 month but SPX returns are negative in >40% of next 20-day windows over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 0.5% but consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains stable, it indicates real economic growth without inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 grows >0.5% and CPIAUCSL growth <1% but SPX returns are negative in >40% of next 60-day windows over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1 index point over one month signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases >1 index point in 1 month
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases >1 index point in 1 month but SPX returns are negative in >40% of next 20-day windows over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 1%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS >1% but SPX returns are positive in >40% of next 20-day windows over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 100,000 jobs in one month but the unemployment rate (UNRATE) does not decrease, it signals labor market tightness without wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases >100k and UNRATE does not decrease but SPX returns are positive in >40% of next 60-day windows over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10,000 units over one month signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases >10k units in 1 month but SPX returns are negative in >40% of next 60-day windows over 2 years.
